crypto_headlines.title: Binance hit by $6.3B hack, the largest crypto theft on record
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance says it reserved $6.34B in company funds to cover all hack losses, with $5B already held in the affected tokens, and is working with the FBI and Secret Service to trace the remaining $3.3B.

crypto_headlines.title: Binance says phased withdrawals could return within about 34 hours
crypto_headlines.summary: Binance said phased withdrawals could start returning within about 34 hours, with fresh Proof of Reserves results due Monday.

crypto_headlines.title: Crypto liquidations hit $1.6B in 24 hours
crypto_headlines.summary: Liquidations reached $1.6B in 24 hours after the hack news, with the largest single order worth $11.09M on Binance.

crypto_headlines.title: BTC ETFs lose $643M, ETH ETFs lose $156M
crypto_headlines.summary: Per SoSoValue, US spot Bitcoin ETFs saw $643M in net outflows on Oct. 30, the largest single day since June, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $234M. Spot Ethereum ETFs lost $156M.

crypto_headlines.title: Lummis says the CLARITY Act would have helped freeze hacked funds
crypto_headlines.summary: Senator Lummis says the CLARITY Act would have given crypto firms legal cover to freeze funds when law enforcement calls. The bill is stuck in the Senate after a 49-50 vote.

crypto_headlines.title: The Bitcoin whitepaper turns 18
crypto_headlines.summary: Satoshi Nakamoto published the Bitcoin whitepaper 18 years ago today, on Oct. 31, 2008.

doginal_news.title: DDMIAMI 2026 schedule: Dec 7 to 9
doginal_news.summary: The DDMIAMI 2026 schedule runs Dec 7 to 9 with an in-person Doginal Dogs Legends championship, a live creator studio and community meetups across Miami.

doginal_news.title: Marketplace still paused for the security review
doginal_news.summary: BradX reports zero listings and no sale since #6717 at 85k DOGE last Saturday while the marketplace stays paused for the security review.

doginal_news.title: Hofers wins Legends KOTH
doginal_news.summary: KennelDAO crowned Hofers champion of its Legends KOTH bracket.

doginal_news.title: First Shiboshi V054 AGS Gem Mint 10 at auction
doginal_news.summary: And's no-reserve auction for the first Shiboshi V054 AGS Gem Mint 10 slab was bid to $202.50 in its final hour.

doginal_news.title: ICE CEO cites Pyth data on oil perpetuals
doginal_news.summary: On ICE's Q3 earnings call, Chair and CEO Jeff Sprecher cited Pyth data on oil perpetuals while discussing how those markets complement traditional futures.

doginal_news.title: Pyth Pro adds China and Japan equities, energy and VIX futures
doginal_news.summary: Pyth Pro expanded coverage with more China equities, additional Japanese equities, more energy commodity futures and VIX futures.

notes: No original posts from @doginaldogs or @DDLTCG in the last 24 hours; items above come from community accounts.
